summary: Fallback to a JavaScript-compatible constructor object when the class binding is used as a runtime value with function/prototype/reflection semantics.

target.notes: Materialize the class constructor object, its prototype object, property descriptors, name/length/prototype properties, static elements, and constructor-object inheritance.

semantics.constructor_inheritance: [[Prototype]] links subclass constructor to base constructor

caveats: System.Type is not behaviorally equivalent to a JavaScript class constructor object.
